The head, body, legs, arms and hands use pieces of the original boss atlas. Hidden joints and covered shotgun sections are reconstructed. The pump moves independently. This is a rig test with recoil, lift, pump and release poses; the final shotgun flourish is a separate animation pass. Extreme manual poses can exceed arm reach—the preview reports those limits. Combat is unchanged.
